known_issues: Chat messages overflow outside the chat box on mobile when messages accumulate

existing_features.title: Prevent chat messages from overflowing outside the chat panel on mobile by ensuring the message list area scrolls vertically while keeping the composer (message input + buttons) visible within the chat card.
Ensure long chat message text wraps onto the next line within the available chat width (including deeply nested replies) without causing horizontal overflow.
Make attached chat images responsive on mobile so that image previews and posted images never exceed the chat panel width and do not contribute to overflow.

Update the chat panel containers where they are embedded (e.g., standalone Chat page and Calendar month page) so the chat region uses a stable, mobile-safe height calculation and does not cause nested overflow issues when the message list scrolls.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix mobile chat overflow: make chat box scroll vertically and wrap long messages to next line

projectName: Fix mobile chat overflow with scrollable message list and wrapped content
